info.name: Verifiable API Documentation Alerts ProvidersInfo API
ProvidersInfo
Get info for the existing provider

params.name: providerId
params.description: Identifier of the provider to get the data for.

params.name: providerInfoType
params.description: If not specified, will return all data for the provider. Info types can be combined, ex.: `providerInfoType=licenses&providerInfoType=deaRegistrations`.

items.docs: Returns the info for a specific provider.

info.name: List all specialties for a provider

items.docs: Retrieves all specialties for a specific provider. A provider can have one Primary, one Secondary, and multiple Additional specialties.

info.name: Create specialty for the existing provider

items.docs: Creates a specialty for a specific provider. Each provider can have one Primary specialty, one Secondary specialty, and multiple Additional specialties. The same taxonomy cannot be used across multiple specialties for the same provider.

info.name: Get specialty by identifier

items.docs: Retrieves a specific specialty for a provider by its identifier.

info.name: Update specialty for a provider

items.docs: Updates a specific specialty for a provider. The same taxonomy cannot be used across multiple specialties for the same provider. Only one Primary and one Secondary specialty is allowed per provider.

info.name: Delete specialty for a provider

items.docs: Deletes a specific specialty for a provider by its identifier.
